name: Mombasa Pilau Kit
short: Everything for a proper Swahili pilau: pishori rice, whole pilau spices, fried onions and our masala paste.
description: Coast pilau is all about the spice base: cumin, cardamom, cloves and cinnamon fried into onions until the kitchen smells like Old Town. This kit bundles 1 kg of Mwea pishori rice, whole and ground pilau masala, crispy onion, garlic-ginger paste and a recipe card from a Mombasa home cook. Add beef or potatoes, stock and 40 minutes. Kachumbari on the side is not optional.
ingredients: Pishori rice, cumin, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, black pepper, bay leaf, dried onion, garlic, ginger, salt.

name: Ugali & Sukuma Wiki Kit
short: Sifted maize flour, a bunch of fresh sukuma wiki, onions, tomatoes and our mchuzi mix. Dinner in 25 minutes.
description: The national plate, sorted. 2 kg of sifted maize flour for a firm ugali, a fresh bunch of sukuma wiki (collard greens) from Kiambu farms, onions, tomatoes and a sachet of our own beef mchuzi mix. Stir, steam, serve. Add wet fry or a fried egg if you are feeling fancy.
ingredients: Sifted maize flour, sukuma wiki, onion, tomato, mchuzi mix (salt, cornflour, onion, garlic, coriander, chilli).

name: Mukimo Kit with Pumpkin Leaves
short: Potatoes, green maize, pumpkin leaves and beans, ready to boil and mash the Nyeri way.
description: Mukimo is the Central Kenya dish that turns up at every wedding and most Sunday lunches. This kit gives you 1 kg of washed potatoes, fresh green maize off the cob, tender pumpkin leaves (or managu when leaves are out of season), pre-soaked njahi beans and a recipe card. Mash it green, serve it with a stew or nyama choma.
ingredients: Potatoes, green maize, pumpkin leaves, njahi (black beans), onion, salt.

name: Beef Pilau, Kilimanjaro Jamia
short: The CBD lunch that never loses: spiced rice, tender beef and a heap of kachumbari from Kilimanjaro Jamia.
description: Kilimanjaro Jamia on Kimathi Street has fed Nairobi office workers for decades, and the beef pilau is the reason. Long-grain rice cooked in a dark, cumin-heavy spice broth with slow-cooked beef chunks, served with fresh kachumbari and a wedge of lime. Delivered hot within Nairobi. Choose Express at checkout for same-day.
ingredients: Rice, beef, onion, tomato, garlic, ginger, pilau masala, cooking oil, salt. Served with kachumbari (tomato, onion, coriander, chilli, lime).

name: Chicken Biryani, Swahili Plate
short: Layered coast-style biryani with a rich chicken masala, from Swahili Plate.
description: Swahili Plate cooks biryani the Mombasa way: fragrant rice tinted with saffron and food colour, layered over a slow-cooked chicken masala thick with tomatoes, yoghurt and whole spices. Comes with kachumbari and a fried potato. One plate is honestly enough for a hungry adult and a half. Delivered hot within Nairobi.
ingredients: Basmati rice, chicken, onion, tomato, yoghurt, garlic, ginger, biryani masala, potato, ghee, coriander, saffron, salt.

name: Whole Fried Tilapia, Mama Oliech
short: Nairobi's most famous fish: a whole deep-fried tilapia with ugali and kachumbari from Mama Oliech.
description: Mama Oliech in Kilimani is where Nairobi goes for fish. A whole Lake Victoria tilapia, deep-fried until the skin crackles, served with a block of ugali and sharp kachumbari. Ask for it wet-fried and it comes in a tomato-onion sauce instead. Delivered hot within Nairobi; choose Express for same-day.
ingredients: Tilapia, cooking oil, salt, maize flour (ugali), tomato, onion, coriander, chilli, lime.

name: Quarter Kuku Choma & Ugali, Kipevu
short: Charcoal-grilled quarter chicken with ugali, kachumbari and a pot of chilli, from Kipevu.
description: Kipevu grills its kuku over charcoal until the skin is blistered and smoky, then sends it out with a wedge of ugali, kachumbari and their house chilli sauce. Swap ugali for chips at no extra cost. Delivered hot within Nairobi.
ingredients: Chicken, salt, lime, garlic, chilli, maize flour (ugali), tomato, onion, coriander.

name: Goat Nyama Choma (½ kg), Kamakis
short: Half a kilo of slow-roasted goat from the Kamakis choma strip, with kachumbari and ugali on the side.
description: Kamakis on the Eastern Bypass is Nairobi's Sunday ritual: rows of grills, smoke, and goat roasted slowly over charcoal until the fat renders and the edges char. This is half a kilo, chopped, with kachumbari, ugali and a sachet of salt-chilli. Delivered within Nairobi; choose Express and it arrives while the meat is still hot.
ingredients: Goat meat, salt, chilli, lime, maize flour (ugali), tomato, onion, coriander.

name: Nyama Choma Rub
short: Coarse salt, black pepper, garlic, chilli and a whisper of lime. Rub, rest, roast.
description: Our house choma rub, blended in small batches in Nairobi: flaky salt, cracked black pepper, dried garlic, bird's eye chilli, coriander seed and dried lime zest. Enough for four kilos of goat, beef or chicken. Rub it in an hour before the meat meets the charcoal and let the fire do the rest.
ingredients: Sea salt, black pepper, dried garlic, bird's eye chilli, coriander seed, dried lime zest.

name: Pilau Masala
short: Freshly ground cumin, cardamom, cloves and cinnamon in the classic Swahili proportions.
description: Ground the week it ships, not the year. Cumin, green cardamom, cloves, cinnamon and black pepper, toasted and ground in Mombasa. One heaped tablespoon per kilo of rice. Also makes an excellent rub for chicken.
ingredients: Cumin, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, black pepper.

name: Kachumbari Chilli Sauce
short: A bright, chunky chilli sauce built on tomato, onion, coriander and lime. Kachumbari in a bottle.
description: We took the kachumbari everyone fights over at the choma joint and cooked it down into a sauce that keeps. Ripe Nakuru tomatoes, red onion, coriander, green chilli and plenty of lime. Spoon it on nyama choma, chips, eggs, anything.
ingredients: Tomato, red onion, green chilli, coriander, lime juice, sugar, salt, vinegar.

name: Sifted Maize Flour (Unga wa Ugali)
short: Fine, white, stone-milled maize flour from Rift Valley maize. Firm ugali every time.
description: Sifted flour from Nakuru maize, milled fresh and packed the same day. Makes a firm, clean ugali that holds together on the plate, and a smooth uji when cooked thin with milk. Zero-rated for VAT in Kenya.
ingredients: Maize.

name: Mwea Pishori Rice
short: Aromatic long-grain rice from the Mwea irrigation scheme. The rice pilau and biryani are built on.
description: Pishori is Kenya's own aromatic rice, grown in the paddies of Mwea in Kirinyaga. Long grains that stay separate, with a nutty smell as soon as it hits the pot. Rinse twice, use 1.5 cups of water to 1 of rice, and do not lift the lid.
ingredients: Rice.

name: Chapati Wheat Flour
short: Soft, high-gluten wheat flour for layered, flaky chapati. Also makes mandazi and mahamri.
description: A finer, softer wheat flour milled for chapati: it rolls thin without tearing and puffs into layers. Enough for about 30 chapatis. Works for mandazi, mahamri and samosa wrappers too.
ingredients: Wheat flour, fortified with iron, zinc and vitamins.

name: Coconut Mandazi Mix
short: Just add water and fry. Coast-style mandazi with coconut and cardamom, ready in 20 minutes.
description: The Swahili breakfast staple, in a bag: flour, coconut milk powder, sugar, cardamom and yeast. Mix with warm water, rest, cut into triangles and fry until golden. Makes about 20. Best with chai, or dunked in mbaazi.
ingredients: Wheat flour, coconut milk powder, sugar, cardamom, yeast, salt.

name: Bhajia Mix with Ukwaju Dip
short: Spiced gram-flour batter for crisp potato bhajia, with a tamarind (ukwaju) dip sachet.
description: Slice potatoes thin, dip in the batter and fry: Mombasa street bhajia at home. Gram flour with coriander, cumin, garlic, turmeric and chilli, plus a sachet of sweet-sour ukwaju sauce. Add a squeeze of lime and a pinch of salt.
ingredients: Gram (chickpea) flour, wheat flour, coriander, cumin, garlic, turmeric, chilli, salt. Dip: tamarind, sugar, chilli, salt.

name: Coconut Kashata
short: Chewy coconut and peanut brittle, cut into squares the Lamu way.
description: Kashata is the coast's answer to fudge: grated coconut and roasted peanuts set in caramelised sugar with a touch of cardamom. Six squares per pack. Sold at every Lamu bus stop, and now at your door.
ingredients: Sugar, grated coconut, roasted peanuts, cardamom.

name: Kericho Black Tea
short: Strong, bright, coppery tea from the Kericho highlands. Made for milk and sugar.
description: Grown at 2,000 metres in Kericho and CTC-processed for a brisk, bright cup that stands up to milk, sugar and ginger. This is the tea in every Kenyan kitchen. Boil it with milk for chai, or add crushed tangawizi for the full experience.
ingredients: Black tea.

name: Kenya AA Ground Coffee
short: Medium roast Kenya AA from Nyeri cooperatives: blackcurrant, citrus and a clean, bright finish.
description: AA is the top screen size for Kenyan beans, and Nyeri grows some of the best. Washed, sun-dried on raised beds and roasted medium in Nairobi. Ground for filter and cafetière. Expect blackcurrant, grapefruit and a long, juicy finish.
ingredients: Roasted arabica coffee.

name: Tangawizi Chai Masala
short: Kericho tea bags blended with ginger, cardamom and cinnamon. Chai masala without the grinding.
description: Kericho black tea with dried tangawizi (ginger), cardamom, cinnamon and cloves in the bag. Brew it in milk for a proper chai masala, or in water for a warming ginger tea. 25 bags.
ingredients: Black tea, ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves.
